description: A waveform of audio: bars or a canvas drawn from peaks or a live signal, a seekable control with a native input, a playhead and thumb that follow a live position, a hover readout, markers, and named regions with draggable edges. Its svelte adapter.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** The levels as a fixed number of elements, one `Waveform.Bar` each, styled in plain CSS from `--waveform-level`. */
let {
  bar,
  count = 24,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Bars>>, "children"> & {
  /** Draws one bar. Left out, plain bars are rendered. */
  bar?: Snippet<[number, number]>;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Bars {count} {...rest}>
  {#snippet children()}
    {#each Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => i) as index (index)}
      {#if bar}
        {@render bar(index, count)}
      {:else}
        <parts.Bar {index} />
      {/if}
    {/each}
  {/snippet}
</parts.Bars>

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/**
 * The seekable surface: a press jumps to the pointer and a drag scrubs. It
 * holds the native `<input type="range">` that takes focus, handles the
 * keyboard and carries the accessible name. Leave it out for a waveform that
 * is only shown.
 */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  getAriaValueText,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Control>>, "children"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
  /** Returns how the position is announced, e.g. `"0:12 of 1:42"`. Defaults to the played share, e.g. `"30%"`. */
  getAriaValueText?: (value: number, duration: number) => string;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Control {...rest}>
  {#snippet children()}
    {@render content?.()}
    <parts.Input
      aria-describedby={describedBy}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
      {getAriaValueText}
    />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Control>

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** Resizes one edge of a region, by dragging or from the keyboard through its native input. */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  edge,
  getAriaValueText,
  region,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.RegionStart>>, "children"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
  /** The edge of the region this handle resizes. */
  edge: "end" | "start";
  /** Returns how the edge's position is announced. Defaults to its share, e.g. `"30%"`. */
  getAriaValueText?: (value: number, duration: number) => string;
  /** The name of the region it belongs to. */
  region: string;
} = $props();
</script>

{#if edge === "start"}
  <parts.RegionStart {...rest} {region}>
    {#snippet children()}
      {@render content?.()}
      <parts.RegionStartInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {getAriaValueText}
        {region}
      />
    {/snippet}
  </parts.RegionStart>
{:else}
  <parts.RegionEnd {...rest} {region}>
    {#snippet children()}
      {@render content?.()}
      <parts.RegionEndInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {getAriaValueText}
        {region}
      />
    {/snippet}
  </parts.RegionEnd>
{/if}
